$comment: Moon's agent-mode definition, sent to TrueForge as an inline AgentSpec when a chat starts. Moon fills the {{...}} placeholders: {{model}} from config/moon.json (models.main, or models.backup on fallback), {{mcpServer}} from mcp.serverName, {{file:...}} with the text of that file (relative to this folder). Phase 1: read-only tools only.
